mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) consistently signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE rises by more than 0.2 percentage points in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A Federal Funds Rate that crosses below 3.0% signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces the cost of capital and stimulates economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 3.0 and FEDFUNDS > 3.0 in prior month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS crosses below 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad-based economic contraction, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 30% of instances when UNRATE rises and INDPRO falls simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market collapse regime (HOUST below 1000 thousand units), weak residential construction activity signals a broader demand slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 40% of instances when HOUST < 1000.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals increasing inflationary pressure, which typically leads to tighter monetary policy and reduced equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises by more than 0.2% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110 signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 35% of instances when INDPRO < 110.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a severe weakening of consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 30% of instances when HOUST and RSAFS both decline.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.2%), the Federal Reserve is expected to raise interest rates, which increases the discount rate for equities and reduces forward earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.2%.
